basic_info.description: 707 19th Avenue is a true gem nestled in San Francisco's desirable Richmond District! Located on a quiet block North of Golden Gate Park between Fulton and Balboa, this darling single-family home offers comfort, character, and room to grow.    Featuring 3 bedrooms and 1 bathroom (per tax records), the home is bathed in natural light, freshly painted, and thoughtfully updated with modern electrical and heating systems making it move-in ready.    The spacious garage offers significant potential for expansion, whether you're thinking of adding living space, a home office, or an in-law unit.    This is a perfect starter home for a first-time buyer who's ready to step into homeownership without sacrificing charm or location. Why settle when you can start here?    Don't miss your chance to own a piece of the Richmond, close to Golden Gate Park, great schools, restaurants, and public transit.
